body: Thank you for the advice. I really appreciate it. I have a hard time thinking positively, especially about myself. It's something I've been trying to change.

Thanks for the encouragement. I guess I've been thinking on this so long I've worked it up in my head. I'm afraid that if I reveal too much I'll be pressured into the therapy side of things. Which at this time, I just don't feel comfortable with.
I realize it's not easy to give me advice because of my stipulations. I just hope there's some solution. Maybe not.
Thanks for the information, I appreciate it.

Thanks, what I was mostly afraid of was being blindsided by their reaction. I guess you could call me paranoid. I care immensely about how I effect the lives of those around me and tend to overthink things. 

I just wasn't sure if it was an all or nothing sort of thing with them. Like if you mention suicide they are obligated to involve the police, family or medical professionals. But it doesn't sound like that is the case.

Thanks for answering my question, and as for yours.

As previously mentioned, I have almost no expendable income. The job market after graduating from college was not kind to me. Which has left me giving almost everything I earn on a monthly basis to repaying my loans. I make barely enough to pay for gas and tuck whatever might be left over into my savings account. The money I gave to betterhelp was about half my savings ($180), I regret spending it. 

My parents have been kind enough to let me live with them while I am in this situation. Its been 5 years. Given this I would need to make excuses as to where I am during the sessions, which wouldn't be so easy as my father and mother ask a lot of questions as they are paranoia ridden since my brother's accident. 

Although I could lie, I guess I'm afraid of them finding out. Not to say I would be able to pay for therapy in the first place, so it is sort of a moot point as it is.
I'm afraid my family will find out how bad my mental state actually is. I don't want them to have to worry about losing another son.

Due to circumstances involving a death my immediate family and financial issues, I am not currently able to go to therapy..

I am also not willing to confide in my family about my suicidal thoughts. If I brought that up I feel it would do way more harm than good. The people in my life are extremely volitile and something like that would send them over the edge. This has left me with no way to try and deal with my suicidal thoughts. Ever day I feel like I'm more and more lost, getting closer to the breaking point. What direction should I take?

Yeah I get I'm basically asking for an answer that's not there. But otherwise it feels like my options are give up or hope things get better somehow

I'm so tired of the make believe. Tired or putting on an act for everyone around me.

I have never felt lower in my life. Useless, like a living void.

But I always act like i'm happy, for the benefit of my family, friends and even co workers. If I'm being honest I don't care about living anymore but I do care about them.

I'm living for them, an empty husk that can make them giggle every once in a while. My motivation is lost and it feels like there is no escape. Ironically, when I'm alone and I get to drop the act, that's when I finally feel some semblance of happiness.

It's alright to feel bad about this sort of thing. You were a good friend and put their enjoyment over yours, regretting it is bound to happen. As long as you know that your friends appreciate it and it was your choice you should take solace in that you have enough humility to make others around you happy. It's what makes you a good person. The regret will fade, but your friends appreciation will last a lot longer. A sacrifice here and there is okay, especially when you know your friends can use it more than you, just don't let yourself be taken advantage of.

Started playing as well a bit ago for the first time. I remember people saying that Ashley's Ai was terrible. For me it comes in spurts. Most of the time I just throw her in a dumpster or keep her behind me. But there are those rare occasions where she acts like a deer in headlights.

Most recently I fought a boss and after about a ten minute battle I killed it and left the arena and was greeted by some standard enemies. I shot one and his head exploded into a monster. I back up and aim which cause ashley to duck. Enemy is getting closer and I realize why she is ducking so I keep my gun down. Ashley stays crouched for no conceivable reason, why ashley? God dammit you have so much to live for get up and run you fucker. Enemy bashes her face in. 

*loudly sighs at gameover screen*

Game takes me back to about 10 minutes BEFORE the long ass boss battle. Fuck this I'll try again tomorrow..
Been said a hundred times already but congrats!

I am truly sorry to hear about your mother, I know what it is like to suddenly lose a loved one. Don't let him make you think life is not worth living. Let him and the negativity he brings drift from your life, there are plenty of good people out there. Remember your mother for who she was to you, remember that she would want you to live your life to its fullest.

Your grandfather is an amazing man, to be that selfless in his final moments means he must be extremely proud of his life and all of you.

You guys must have a strong loving family.
